dungeons_iso.binds.lockOn: Hold to disable locking on to enemy position
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.dungeons_: Changes Minecraft's perspective to be more like Minecraft Dungeons.
dungeons_iso.config.title: §6Dungeons Perspective
dungeons_iso.config.fogOfWar.name: Fog of War
dungeons_iso.config.fogOfWar.description: While enabled, things you shouldn't be able to see will be obscured by a fog of war.
dungeons_iso.config.distanceFog.name: Distance Fog
dungeons_iso.config.distanceFog.descript: Pushes a distance fog band out with the isometric zoom to hide distant rendering artifacts. Disable to see farther, at the cost of visible far-chunk glitches.
dungeons_iso.config.renderDistanceCap.de: Caps Sodium's render distance to a zoom-based radius while the perspective is active, instead of using your full video-settings render distance. Disable to render chunks out to your normal render distance.
dungeons_iso.config.cullangle.name: Cull Radius
dungeons_iso.config.cullangle.descriptio: Increase or decrease the radius of the culling cylinder.
dungeons_iso.config.coneHalfAngle.name: Cone Half-Angle
dungeons_iso.config.coneHalfAngle.descri: The half-angle of the cone near the player that tapers the culling area. Lower values create a narrower cone, reducing culling of nearby blocks.
dungeons_iso.config.xiv.name: XIV Mode
dungeons_iso.config.xiv.description: While enabled, dragging the mouse up and down while holding Move Camera adjusts the Pitch instead of the Zoom.
dungeons_iso.config.scrollWheelZoom.name: Scroll wheel zoom
dungeons_iso.config.scrollWheelZoom.desc: Zoom with scroll wheel (overrides hotbar scrolling).
dungeons_iso.config.bias.name: Sound Listener Bias
dungeons_iso.config.bias.description: How close the camera is to the player for the purpose of sound.
dungeons_iso.config.cameraRelative.name: Camera-relative movement
dungeons_iso.config.cameraRelative.descr: Make movement work relative to the camera instead of the player. (Recommended with Turn to Mouse On, when Off)
dungeons_iso.config.joystickMovement.des: Drive movement with a connected controller's left analog stick. The stick overrides the keyboard while pushed past the deadzone. Always on in Controller Mode.
dungeons_iso.config.lockOnTargeting.name: Lock-on targeting
dungeons_iso.config.lockOnTargeting.desc: Cycle through mobs with a keybind. Locked-on mobs override cursor targeting.
Toggles if this feature is allowed on the server.
dungeons_iso.config.capabilities:
Additional features that aren't vanilla server friendly.
§eThese must be allowed by the server operator. On local worlds, commands must be enabled.
dungeons_iso.config.targetFromCamera.des: Pick target from cursor position, bypassing player line of sight.
dungeons_iso.config.unlimitedReach.name: Unlimited reach
dungeons_iso.config.unlimitedReach.descr: Allow interaction with blocks no matter how far from the player they are.
dungeons_iso.config.dynamic_camera.name: Context Based Smooth Camera
dungeons_iso.config.dynamic_camera.descr: Offsets the camera based on your current speed vector.
dungeons_iso.config.movefactor.name: Smooth Camera Move Factor
dungeons_iso.config.movefactor.descripti: Subtly changes motion of smooth camera.
dungeons_iso.config.fov.name: Default FOV
dungeons_iso.config.fov.description: FOV that the game starts in.
dungeons_iso.config.force_no_defer.name: Force never deferring chunks
dungeons_iso.config.force_no_defer.descr: Might help to turn off if you are experiencing lag. Turn Always Chunk Deferring on in Sodium as well if you turn this off.
dungeons_iso.config.click_to_move.name: Click To Move (Not working on Neoforge)
dungeons_iso.config.click_to_move.descri: Turn on to experience the mod in Click To Move mode.
dungeons_iso.config.turn_to_mouse.name: Always Rotate Towards Mouse
dungeons_iso.config.turn_to_mouse.descri: Turn on always be rotated towards the mouse when not on a mount. Otherwise, you sometimes move towards your movement.
dungeons_iso.config.force.name: Force Perspective
dungeons_iso.config.force.description: Force the perspective to always be on.
Turn off Minecraft's occlusion-based chunk culling so chunks around the offset isometric camera don't disappear. Applied on load; toggling takes effect immediately.
dungeons_iso.config.onStartup.name: Force on Startup
dungeons_iso.config.onStartup.descriptio: Turn the perspective on upon first loading into a world in your session.
dungeons_iso.config.forceAutoJump.name: Force AutoJump in Click To Move
dungeons_iso.config.forceAutoJump.descri: Force AutoJump in Click To Move.
dungeons_iso.config.zoomFactor.name: Zoom and FOV factor
dungeons_iso.config.rollTowardsCursor.de: When enabled, you will roll towards the cursor rather than in the direction you're moving.
dungeons_iso.config.additionalMeleeAssis: Look at clicked target for 1 second after click
When enabled, you will snap towards targets you click for 1 second after the click. Helps with melee.
Automatically face an appropriate nearby enemy while attacking, aiming, or casting.
dungeons_iso.config.movementTargeting.de: Use movement direction instead of the cursor to acquire contextual combat targets.
dungeons_iso.config.contextualInteract.d: Select nearby usable blocks such as chests, doors, furnaces, buttons, and levers for the Interact key.
dungeons_iso.config.controllerMode.name: Controller Mode
dungeons_iso.config.controllerMode.descr: Controller-friendly preset: disables turn-to-mouse and click-to-move, enables contextual movement targeting and interaction, and preserves the underlying saved settings.
dungeons_iso.config.clipToSpace.name: Additional Zoom Effects
dungeons_iso.config.clipToSpace.descript: Additonal Automatic Zoom in and out depending on certain events.
dungeons_iso.config.ortho.name: Orthographic Mode
dungeons_iso.config.ortho.description: Makes all blocks the same size regardless of distance. RTS-Like.
dungeons_iso.config.frustumCulling.name: Frustum Culling
dungeons_iso.config.frustumCulling.descr: Adds a frustum shape that culls blocks before it, making traversing through caves easier. Improves performance, but can be distracting. May make buildings look weird.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCulling.name: Room roof culling
dungeons_iso.config.roomCulling.descript: Detects enclosed rooms and removes their roof and supporting cover while the perspective is active.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeCulling.name: Shape culling
dungeons_iso.config.shapeCulling.descrip: Removes terrain shapes that obstruct the line of sight between the camera and player.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostCulledBlocks.de: Draw removed blocks back as translucent geometry instead of leaving a void.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostClearScreen.des: Controls the transparent pocket around the player.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostOpaqueScreen.de: Controls how quickly ghosted terrain reaches full opacity.
dungeons_iso.config.ghostMaxAlpha.name: Ghost maximum opacity
dungeons_iso.config.ghostMaxAlpha.descri: Maximum opacity used for ghosted terrain.
dungeons_iso.config.showFirstTimeGui.des: When enabled, shows a prompt the first time you join a world asking whether to enable or disable the top-down perspective on login. Re-enabling this resets your previous choice.
dungeons_iso.firsttime.title: §6Dungeons Perspective
dungeons_iso.firsttime.description: Would you like to enable the top-down perspective when joining worlds? You can change this later.
dungeons_iso.config.roomRadius.name: Room radius
dungeons_iso.config.roomRadius.descripti: Maximum horizontal reach of the room flood, in blocks. Walls normally stop it well before this; it is a safety cap, not the boundary.
dungeons_iso.config.roomWallThickness.de: How far the room footprint grows outward to swallow the surrounding walls. Too low and the roof above the walls survives as a rim.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCeilingTolerance: How far below your own ceiling height the room flood may still go. Lower values keep the flood from spilling through doorway lintels; raise it for stepped or vaulted ceilings.
dungeons_iso.config.roomCoverHeight.name: Cover removal height
dungeons_iso.config.roomCoverHeight.desc: How far above the room ceiling to keep removing blocks, allowing upper floors and roofs above an indoor space to be cut away.
dungeons_iso.config.roomMaxVolume.name: Max room volume
dungeons_iso.config.roomMaxVolume.descri: Cells visited before the space is judged a cave system rather than a room.
Chunk sections re-meshed per tick, shared by both cullers. This directly trades responsiveness for frame time.
dungeons_iso.config.roomNodesPerSlice.de: Cells the scanner visits before yielding. Lower values spread a scan over more ticks.
dungeons_iso.config.roomRescanCooldown.d: Minimum ticks between room scans, in addition to requiring movement into a different block.
dungeons_iso.config.disableOcclusionCull: Disables renderer occlusion culling while blocks are removed. Leave off unless terrain disappears incorrectly through a cutaway.
dungeons_iso.config.cullDebugLog.name: Log culling state
dungeons_iso.config.cullDebugLog.descrip: Writes culling diagnostics to the log once per second for troubleshooting.
dungeons_iso.config.unifiedSilhouette.de: Cut a silhouette-shaped opening through whatever blocks the view instead of attempting to identify and remove whole objects.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainSilhouetteCul: Allow natural ground to start a silhouette opening. Disable this to leave hillsides and cliffs untouched.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainSilhouetteDil: How far the terrain opening grows beyond blocks directly obstructing the view.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainOccludeThresh: Fraction of sample rays a shape must block before it counts as hiding the player.
dungeons_iso.config.sightlineSuppressThr: Above this fraction of unobstructed rays, nothing is culled.
dungeons_iso.config.terrainShapeCap.name: Shape size cap
dungeons_iso.config.terrainShapeCap.desc: Maximum blocks in a terrain shape before it is treated as unresolved and skipped.
dungeons_iso.config.treeShapeCap.name: Tree size cap
dungeons_iso.config.treeShapeCap.descrip: Maximum blocks in a tree shape before it is treated as unresolved and skipped.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxSpan.name: Shape max width
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxSpan.descrip: Maximum horizontal width of a resolved shape, separating individual objects from connected terrain or forests.
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxHeight.name: Shape max height
dungeons_iso.config.shapeMaxHeight.descr: Maximum height of a resolved shape before it is skipped.
dungeons_iso.config.treeLeafSpread.name: Canopy reach from trunk
dungeons_iso.config.treeLeafSpread.descr: Maximum leaf distance from the nearest log used to keep touching trees from merging into one shape.
dungeons_iso.config.sightlineMaxCulledBl: Maximum blocks removed at once across all shapes.
Camera movement in blocks that forces a fresh cast before the cooldown expires.
dungeons_iso.config.requires_yacl: Install YetAnotherConfigLib to open the settings screen. Settings still load and save without it.
